name: Micro Cap Catalyst
tagline: Screens the small-cap catalyst calendar and proposes next moves for your review
description: Built around a US small-cap book you run one name at a time. Once the cash close is in, it screens the coming catalyst calendar for that holding and comes back with a hold, sell or buy proposal. Nothing executes by itself: every exact order waits for your approval, and the read is a starting point, not advice.
author: mintotsai
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
